This agent uses the overriden and added script functions to HPL2-1.2 patch,
that are unique to AMFP and not used anywhere else.
It does not have web access, only local files.

See [copilot_hpl2/updates_amfp/amfp_scripts.hps](copilot_hpl2/updates_amfp/amfp_scripts.hps) for syntax.
See [copilot_hpl2/amfp_maps](copilot_hpl2/amfp_maps) for base game examples on function usage.
